label: Organic Light
description: Natural and practical light sources with soft, believable falloff — the intimate end of the lighting spectrum.

items.name: window-light
items.text: soft directional daylight from a single large window, gentle falloff into shadow, dust visible in the beam

items.name: sheer-curtain-glow
items.text: daylight diffused through sheer curtains, wrapping soft light with barely defined shadows

items.name: blinds-slats
items.text: low sun slicing through venetian blinds, parallel bands of warm light raking across the scene

items.name: candlelight
items.text: warm flickering candlelight, deep amber tones, intimate pools of light and soft darkness

items.name: fireplace-glow
items.text: the restless orange glow of a fireplace, warm highlights dancing on nearby surfaces

items.name: string-lights
items.text: warm fairy string lights, small soft points of glow and creamy bokeh in the background

items.name: bedside-lamp
items.text: a single warm bedside lamp, cozy low-key light with soft shadow edges

items.name: golden-hour-window
items.text: late golden-hour sun pouring horizontally through a window, long warm shadows and glowing edges

items.name: overcast-softbox
items.text: bright overcast sky acting as one huge softbox, shadowless even light with true colors

items.name: dappled-leaves
items.text: sunlight dappled through foliage, shifting spots of light and leaf-shadow patterns
